title: Margherita Pizza
desc: Home-oven pizza with tomato and mozzarella.
steps: Preheat to 250°C conventional with a pizza stone or heavy tray inside for 40 minutes.
Use prepared dough at room temperature. Divide into portions of about 250 g and stretch each on a lightly floured surface to about 28 cm.
Spread the prepared tomato sauce thinly over each base, leaving a rim. Divide the mozzarella over the pizzas.
Drizzle with olive oil.
Transfer carefully to the hot surface and bake in batches for 8–12 minutes until the base is crisp and the rim browned. Finish with basil and serve.

title: Pepperoni Pizza
desc: Home-oven pizza with tomato and mozzarella.
steps: Preheat to 250°C conventional with a pizza stone or heavy tray inside for 40 minutes.
Use prepared dough at room temperature. Divide into portions of about 250 g and stretch each on a lightly floured surface to about 28 cm.
Spread the prepared tomato sauce thinly over each base, leaving a rim. Divide the mozzarella over the pizzas.
Add pepperoni evenly, then drizzle with oil.
Transfer carefully to the hot surface and bake in batches for 8–12 minutes until the base is crisp and the rim browned. Finish with basil and serve.

title: Garlic Naan
desc: Soft pan-cooked flatbreads with garlic butter.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, sugar and salt. Add lukewarm water, yoghurt and oil and knead for 8 minutes until soft and elastic.
Cover and leave for 1 hour until doubled. Divide into portions of about 120 g and roll into thin ovals with a little dusting flour.
Heat a dry heavy frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook each naan for 2–3 minutes per side until puffed, browned and cooked through.
Melt butter with garlic over low heat for 1 minute. Brush over the hot breads and scatter with coriander.

title: Pita Bread
desc: Soft pocket breads baked on a hot tray.
steps: Mix flour, yeast and salt, then add lukewarm water and oil. Knead for 10 minutes until smooth.
Cover and rise for 1 hour until doubled. Preheat to 250°C conventional with a heavy tray inside.
Divide into portions of about 100 g. Roll with dusting flour into even 5 mm thick discs; keep covered and rest for 15 minutes.
Bake on the hot tray in batches for 4–6 minutes until puffed and lightly coloured. Wrap in a clean towel to keep soft.

title: Flammkuchen
desc: A thin yeast-dough version with cream, onion and bacon.
steps: Preheat to 240°C conventional with a heavy tray inside for 30 minutes.
Divide prepared dough into portions of about 150 g. Roll very thinly on baking paper with a little dusting flour.
Spread with crème fraîche, season with pepper and scatter with thin onion and bacon.
Slide onto the hot tray and bake for 10–14 minutes until the base is crisp and the bacon is cooked. Serve immediately.

title: Calzone
desc: Folded pizza with spinach and cheese.
steps: Preheat to 220°C fan. Wilt spinach in a covered pan over low heat, then cool and squeeze very dry; chop.
Divide prepared dough into portions of about 300 g. Roll into rounds on a lightly floured surface.
Mix spinach, ricotta, mozzarella, salt and pepper. Spread prepared tomato sauce over one half of each round and divide the filling over it, leaving a clear border.
Fold over and firmly crimp the edges. Brush with oil and cut a small steam vent. Bake for 20–25 minutes until golden and hot throughout.
